question: The Maritime Anti-Piracy Act, 2022, received the assent of the President on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tue Jan 31 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Maritime Anti-Piracy Act, 2022** received the assent of the President on **Tue Jan 31 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**.
 
• The Act aims to provide an effective legal framework to combat piracy and ensure the safety and security of maritime trade routes.
 
• It defines piracy and prescribes stringent punishments for those involved in such activities.
 
• The Act aligns with India's commitment to international conventions and treaties on maritime safety and security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Piracy** is defined under the Act as any illegal act of violence, detention, or depredation committed for private ends by the crew or passengers of a private ship or aircraft, and directed on the high seas against another ship or aircraft, or against persons or property on board such ship or aircraft.
 
• The Act extends to the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) of India and applies to all persons irrespective of their nationality.
 
• The legislation also provides for the establishment of designated courts for the speedy trial of piracy-related offenses.
